text:
sam: Quick sync  draft partner-pilot acceptance + feedback routing. Core: cohort 8-12, onboarding >=75% in 14 days, no P0s first 7 days, structured feedback into Product/ML/Eng. Thoughts?
olivia: Looks good. Ops notes: cap concurrent heavy partners to 3 until Dedicated autoscaling validated. Require canonical prompt pack before acceptance.
diego: I can own the prompt pack. Recommend 10-12 prompts: short, long-context, tool calls, structured outputs, 2 embedding queries. Run during onboarding and daily via harness.
rachel: Legal/KMS note: intake must include PII checkbox. Private VPC/HSM requests -> mark private-preview and send to Ops for provisioning. DPA required before credits.
tony: Success metrics proposal: week-2 NPS >=6/10, median daily tokens >600 for half the cohort, >=1 actionable item logged per partner, top-4 value interviews.
pilot-bot: Use intake template https://internal.redwood/apply/pilot-template and tag submissions (region, workload-type, private-request).
olivia: For feedback routing: triage rules by keyword -> "accuracy/regression" -> ML, "latency/crash" -> Eng-runtime, "UX/confusing" -> Product. Weekly digest posts to #product-pilot-feedback.
diego: I'll ship a lightweight eval harness that runs the prompt pack daily and reports latency, success-rate, embedding drift. Need eng-runtime for trace hooks and kv cache metrics.
rachel: Incentives: $1k credit + 3 months priority support for high-signal partners. Legal will block credits until DPA signed.
sam: Launch gating: soft private preview if >=3 partners finish onboarding with no P0s for 7 days; broader private preview after 10 partners with NPS and eval pass. Add rollback: repeatable P1 within 72h triggers canary rollback + incident review.
tony: Pre-accept checklist: intake form, prompt pack, infra whitelist, monitoring hooks (trace + kv metrics), trial SLA signed.
diego: I'll add prompt template to intake form and PR the eval harness README by EOD.
sam: Who runs partner weekly syncs? I can do kickoff intros.
tony: I'll run weekly syncs and own scorecard + first two value interviews.
rachel: I'll track legal/KMS/VPC gating and flag private deployment partners.
olivia: I'll build triage automation and the weekly digest channel.
pilot-bot: Reminder: fill intake form before scheduling kickoff.
sam: I'll update the pilot plan doc with gates and post recruitment today. :thumbsup:
